title: Invekto Lisanslama Sayfası — Superadmin
summary: Superadmin paneline tenant başına lisans yönetimi sayfası eklendi. İki kaynak: INMA WaClient.Management SQL Server (readonly — LicenseExpireDate, UserCount, InstanceCount, LicenseHistories) + Invekto PostgreSQL (plan_tier, features_json, tenant_usage). Yeni backend endpoint GET /api/ops/tenants/{id}/license, Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 5.2.2 NuGet eklendi, appsettings.json InmaManagementDb connection string eklendi. React: yeni LicensesPage.tsx sayfası (sol: tenant listesi, sağ: split panel INMA readonly + Invekto editable plan tier/feature override/usage bar), App.tsx route + Layout.tsx nav item eklendi.

files_changed.change: +InmaManagementDb connection string (empty, prod filled via appsettings.Production.json)
+inmaConnectionString var, +GET /api/ops/tenants/{id}/license endpoint (PG + MSSQL dual query, fail-safe inma:null)
+PlanDefinition, InmaLicenseHistory, InmaLicenseInfo, InvektoLicenseInfo, TenantLicenseInfo interfaces; +getTenantLicense, updateTenantPlan, getPlans methods
New licensing management page — split panel (tenant list + license detail panel with INMA readonly + Invekto editable sections)

Expired license shows red banner, 30-day warning shows amber, active shows green?
Feature override JSON textarea accepts null (empty) to clear override via PUT?
Microsoft.Data.SqlClient SqlException caught and silently logged (not 500)?
